target_platform: NVIDIA Jetson Orin / x86-64 RTX GPU (DeepStream 7.0 / TensorRT 10.x)
problem_statement: Retail stores suffer from lost sales, customer churn, and operational inefficiency due to unmonitored checkout queue buildup, aisle congestion, and lack of real-time store occupancy analytics.

functional_requirements.description: Real-time detection of customers and staff in wide-angle overhead RTSP video stream at 60 FPS.
Continuous ID assignment across frame occlusions using NvDCF (NVIDIA Deep Color Features) tracker.
Bi-directional entrance boundary line crossing detection (Customer IN / OUT counting).

functional_requirements.category: Edge Analytics - Queue ROI & Dwell Time
functional_requirements.description: Dynamic polygon ROI monitoring around checkout counters. Track queue head count and cumulative waiting dwell time.
Trigger real-time alert event when queue size exceeds 4 customers for > 15 seconds. Publish MQTT dispatch message to call next available cashier and signal hardware beacon.
functional_requirements.protocol: MQTT 3.1.1 / JSON over WebSockets / Serial UART to ESP32
